global_goals: Optimize Memory and Compute Resources for Edge AI Applications
Enhance Inference Speed and Efficiency on Mobile and Embedded Devices
Develop Adaptive, Energy-Aware Algorithms for Real-Time Processing

repo_mapping.core-inference-engine: Needs research on adaptive quantization, memory optimization, and hardware-specific tuning for efficient inference.
repo_mapping.galaxy-vision-pipeline: Requires advancements in real-time image signal processing, efficient CNN and Vision Transformer architectures, and low-power computer vision techniques.
repo_mapping.on-device-llm-runtime: Demands innovative solutions for KV cache compression, speculative decoding, and energy-aware algorithms to enhance on-device LLM performance.
